exposure: time of birth (according to policy adjustments)
cohort: 11,718 women who gave birth in November of 2012, 2014, and 2016 in Zhejiang Province, China
finding: After the end of China's one-child policy, the proportion of multiparous women, women aged ≥35 years, those with higher education, previous cesarean sections, and delivering in higher-level hospitals increased, with corresponding increases in pregnancy complications and multiple births.
mod_finding: CS risk decreased significantly in 2014 compared to 2012.
